en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a river curving through a narrow wooded valley. On the left bank stands a row of early‑20th‑century European buildings, including one with a small steeple or tower, fronted by a riverside promenade lined with trees. Dense forested hills rise steeply behind the town, and a small bridge crosses the river in the mid‑distance. The overall look is of a spa or resort town in a mountainous region. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the image side.
